sentences.text: Marble Hill is the northernmost neighborhood in the New York City borough of Manhattan .	City	City	Manhattan	Manhattan	New York City	New York City	borough	borough (New York City)
It is the only Manhattan neighborhood on the mainland of North America .	Manhattan	Manhattan	North America	North America
Marble Hill was occupied as a Dutch colonial settlement in 1646 , and gained its current name in 1891 because of marble deposits underneath the neighborhood .	marble	Tuckahoe marble

Politically a part of Manhattan and New York County , Marble Hill became an island in the Harlem River when it was separated from the island of Manhattan by the construction of the Harlem Ship Canal in 1895 .	Manhattan	Manhattan	Harlem River	Harlem River	island of Manhattan	Manhattan island	Harlem Ship Canal	Harlem Ship Canal
In 1914 , the Harlem River was filled in on the north side of Marble Hill , connecting it to the North American mainland and the Bronx .	Harlem River	Harlem River	the Bronx	the Bronx

Because of this change in geography , Marble Hill is often associated with the Bronx and is part of two of the latter 's Community Board Districts .	the Bronx	the Bronx	Community Board Districts	Community boards of New York City
